run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the number of binary trees for a given preorder sequence length n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets to validate correctness
summarize_f_gold: summarize how f_gold uses dynamic programming to compute Catalan numbers for binary tree counting
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use memoization or a closed-form Catalan number formula instead of DP
review_f_gold: review f_gold and the test harness that compares f_filled results against the gold standard
